## What's new in v3.1.0

- Import a course outline or lesson plan and inspect its parsed document state. After an AI model and the required search provider are configured, the app can derive structured themes and search intent from the imported text.
- Review candidates in the right-side Discovery, Browser, and AI Assistant tabs. Read public HTTPS source text, then explicitly save a candidate to the media library or insert a citation into a lesson.
- Stop, continue, and retry discovery work while retaining completed candidates and evidence. Reader state and parsed document status are bounded session metadata.
- Use the updated four-cell green brand mark and generated macOS, Windows, and PNG icon assets.
- Reduce repeated always-visible help text while retaining security, credential, save, recovery, and provider-configuration guidance.

## Verification limits

Live model extraction and the complete external search workflow were not tested: no Brave Search or YouTube Data API credentials were available in the validation environment. Public HTTPS source reading was tested against `https://example.com/`, and private-loopback URLs were rejected. The release report will distinguish native Tauri checks from helper tests and untested system-platform icon surfaces.

## Release verification

The stable [v3.1.0 GitHub Release page](https://github.com/wyzh0117/workbench/releases/tag/v3.1.0) is the source of truth for publication status, the tag-triggered workflow, downloadable assets, and their SHA-256 verification. The final HTML acceptance report records the same verified results and any remaining limits.
